overview.purpose: Official Discord bot for Purdue Network, a Minecraft server linked to Discord. Handles student verification, temporary voice channels, support tickets, chat moderation (relays flagged Minecraft chat to Discord staff), and admin controls.
overview.storage: SQLite (data/boilercraft.db) via aiosqlite + JSON files in data/

env_vars.DISCORD_TOKEN: Required. Bot token from Discord Developer Portal.

keys.BOT_DESCRIPTION: Official Discord Bot for Purdue Network Minecraft Server
keys.CAMPUSES: west_lafayette, northwest, fort_wayne, indianapolis — each with name/emoji/color

keys.CAMPUS_ROLES: Dict mapping each campus key to a Discord role ID

setup_hook_sequence: Load all cogs from cogs/ directory (dynamic import)
Sync slash commands (guild-scoped if GUILD_ID set, else global)
on_ready_sequence: Restore ticket panel from config if channel is set
Start background loops: poll_dashboard_commands (5s), members_cache_loop (30s), server_analytics_loop (5m)

connection_events.on_disconnect: Logs warning, relies on discord.py auto-reconnect
connection_events.on_resumed: Restarts any dead task loops via _restart_task_loops()

background_tasks.name: poll_dashboard_commands
background_tasks.purpose: Executes commands queued by the Nova web dashboard

background_tasks.name: members_cache_loop
background_tasks.purpose: Snapshot of every guild member (id, names, avatar, roles, joined_at, status) for the dashboard to read

background_tasks.name: server_analytics_loop
background_tasks.purpose: Polls mc.esports.purdue.edu via mcsrvstat.us API, logs online/player-count snapshots
background_tasks.retention: 30 days (~8640 entries), atomic write via temp file + os.replace()

helper_functions._save_user_record(user_id, action_type,: Appends a moderation record to data/user_records/{user_id}_record.json (source='website')

safe_json.py.safe_json_dump(data, filepath, **kwargs): Atomic write: temp file in same dir then os.replace(); auto-creates parent dirs; cleans up temp file on error

database.py.init: SQLite at config.DATABASE_PATH, WAL mode, 5s busy timeout

verified_users: add_verified_user(discord_id, minecraft_username, minecraft_uuid, first_name, email, phone, campus)

commands.name: /stop
commands.does: Shuts bot down immediately via bot.close()

commands.name: /sync
commands.does: Manually re-syncs slash commands, reports count

commands.name: /status
commands.does: Bot version, latency, guild/user/bot counts, cogs, commands

commands.name: /mc-maintenance-announcement
commands.does: Posts maintenance embed to announce channel, pings @minecraft role

cogs.error_handler: admin_error(): CheckFailure -> permission-denied message; other exceptions -> generic ephemeral error

cogs.purpose: Student verification flow: modal form -> Mojang username check -> email domain check -> campus role select -> role assignment

validates: MC username format + existence via Mojang API

views.CampusSelectView: Dropdown: West Lafayette / Northwest / Fort Wayne / Indianapolis -> assigns VERIFIED_ROLE_ID + campus role, saves to DB, deletes original welcome message

events.on_member_join: Sends welcome message with Start Verification button to #start-here, stores message id

commands.name: /setup_verification
commands.does: Deploys the persistent verification panel to current channel

commands.name: /unverify
commands.does: Removes verified + campus role, deletes DB record

events.on_ready: Cleans up orphaned channels, starts periodic_cleanup loop
events.on_voice_state_update: Creates temp VC when a generator channel is joined; deletes temp VC when it becomes empty

background_task.name: periodic_cleanup
background_task.does: Deletes empty temp VCs + removes orphaned DB rows

commands.name: /help
commands.does: Full command list grouped by category, admin section only shown to admins

commands.name: /serverinfo
commands.does: Server stats: members, channels, owner, creation date, boosts, roles, emoji

commands.name: /userinfo
commands.does: Profile: join/creation date, top 10 roles, Minecraft username if verified

cogs.purpose: Watches DiscordSRV console channel(s) for Minecraft chat, flags toxic/banned words, alerts staff
message_parsing: Whisper pattern: 'player issued server command: /w target message'
cogs.dedup: Whisper text suppresses a matching public-chat line for 30s (DiscordSRV sometimes double-relays)

commands.name: /blacklist-tickets
commands.does: Blocks a user from opening tickets

commands.name: /whitelist-tickets
commands.does: Removes a user from the ticket blacklist

flow: TicketPanelView: 'Contact Support' button -> IssueTypeSelectView dropdown (dynamic from support_categories)
on_submit validates: not blacklisted, verified (unless admin/staff), valid email domain, no duplicate open ticket
creates channel in 'MC Tickets' category named mc-ticket-0001 etc, posts ticket embed + TicketAdminView (Take Ticket / Close Ticket)
closure: Both paths: collect last 100 messages as transcript, post to auto-created #mc-ticket-logs channel, move entry JSON open->closed, DM user, delete channel after 2s

data_files.data/bot_config.json: Ticket settings, staff role, channel IDs, support categories
data_files.data/dashboard_commands.json: Queue of pending commands from the Nova web dashboard

database_schema.verified_users: discord_id PK, minecraft_username, minecraft_uuid, first_name, email, phone, campus, verified_at
database_schema.temp_vc_generators: id PK autoincrement, join_channel_id UNIQUE, category_id, name, created_at

startup_scripts.start.bat: Sets console title/colors, shows ASCII banner, cd to bot dir, runs 'python bot.py', pauses on exit
startup_scripts.stop_bot.bat: Kills window titled 'BoilerCraftGG*' + any process whose command line matches 'BoilerCraftGG*bot.py', waits 2s
